description: Montana: commercial, industrial and mixed-use parcels from the Montana State Library statewide Cadastral Framework (Montana Department of Revenue ORION CAMA attributes), for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/sources/mt-msl-cadastral.md.

sources.publisher: Montana State Library, with the Montana Department of Revenue and Flathead, Missoula, Ravalli, Silver Bow and Yellowstone Counties
sources.license: No licence stated. The Montana State Library data-list record and metadata give a warranty disclaimer ('provided in good faith but does not represent or warrant its accuracy'; 'for informational purposes only') and a notice that Montana Code Annotated 2-6-109 (the record's metadata cites 2-6-1017) bars using a list of persons prepared by a public agency as a mailing or distribution list without the listed persons' permission, a misdemeanor. The data are public records (Mont. Const. art. II, sec. 9; MCA 2-6-102) offered as a free download with no login, form or fee
sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the publisher; no restriction found
sources.redistribution: Not restricted beyond the mailing-list statute: the registry stores no natural-person owner names, is not a mailing list and does not distribute lists of persons. Attribution: Montana State Library, Montana Department of Revenue
sources.notes: Statewide Montana Cadastral Framework (taxable and tax-exempt parcels for most of Montana), copied from the Department of Revenue's ORION CAMA database; maintained by the Department of Revenue except Ravalli, Silver Bow, Missoula, Flathead and Yellowstone counties, which the counties maintain; integrated monthly by the State Library (metadata date 2026-10-06). File: MTParcels_SHP.zip, 518,095,964 bytes (shapefile; the same layer is MTParcels_GDB.zip, 249,250,816 bytes; StatewideCama.zip, 80,238,862 bytes, holds CAMA building tables only, no owner). The adapter reads the shapefile's DBF attribute table (920,986 records). The 2026 file's PropType is the Department of Revenue's words, not the two-letter codes in the metadata: Improved Property 429,780 (every improved parcel, residential and commercial alike, so commercial cannot be told apart), Vacant Land 286,144, Exempt Property 101,441, Apartment 6,060, Industrial Property 1,468, Condominium, Townhouse, Mobile/RV Parks and others. Only the classes that name themselves are mapped: Apartment -> B, Industrial Property -> F2 (and the legacy IR - Industrial Rural -> F2); commercial parcels need the State Library's CAMA tables (StatewideCama.zip, a file geodatabase) and are not loaded. robots.txt: ftpgeoinfo.msl.mt.gov has none (404); mslservices.mt.gov was read once (data-list record). The State Library's ArcGIS REST service (gisservice.mt.gov) is NOT used: its robots.txt disallows /arcgis/* (one metadata request to /ArcGIS/rest/ was made before this was noticed, see the review record). Fetched from GitHub's network (draft release), not the review machine.
